_comment: Config DELTA template for SSH-idle expiry (docs/adr/0008-ssh-idle-expiry.md). Merge by hand into the real vmapi config; never commit real paths or secrets. The known_hosts file must be operator-maintained, 0644/0600, owned by root or the service user, and contain the guests' SSH host keys (it is never auto-populated). Guests need iproute2 `ss`. Without shutdown_known_hosts_file no VM is deleted for idleness.
